name: Aemilia Robinson
source:
Though she could be a tad bit ditsy, Aemilia is someone who can be counted on if you ever want a friend you know will care for you. That's what made her catch the attention of Saki at a very young age. Saki always had trouble getting along with others but Aemilia always stood by her.

Aemilia first attended the Hyde Colligate Institute as a child and managed to become friends with everyone, but especially close friends with Saki, Shuyaku, and Liam. She is also the captain of the track team.

Due to Liam being a bit of a bit of a jock, Aemilia likes to tease him to see his more embarrassed side. Shuyaku in turn likes to tease her back to get back at her for teasing his best mate while Saki gets defensive on Aemilia's behalf.

This is the dynamic between the whole friend group.
